_readme: Five HTTP tools for the voice agent. Replace {BASE_URL} with PUBLIC_BASE_URL and {TOOL_SECRET} with the value in .env. Schemas are JSON Schema in the common OpenAI function-calling shape, so they paste into most platforms. Every tool returns JSON with a `say` field: the agent must speak it word for word. Every tool answers in under 4 seconds, even when something fails. If your platform can inject the call id and caller number as variables, map them to call_id and caller_phone; if not, leave them out and the backend links calls by phone number.

function.name: evaluate_enquiry
function.description: Send every fact the caller has said so far about their project. Returns the studio's decision (outcome: ASK, QUALIFIED, NURTURE, DECLINE, ESCALATE) and `say`, the exact sentence to speak next. Call again whenever the caller adds or corrects a fact. Never decide fit yourself.

facts.description: Only what the caller actually said. Leave out anything unknown.

project_category.description: residential, office, clinic, studio, or what they said (restaurant, gym, shop…)

caller_confirms_pune_pcmc.description: Only after the tool asked whether the place is in Pune/PCMC

deadline_text.description: When it must be complete, in the caller's words

deadline_date.description: Exact completion date if given, YYYY-MM-DD

deadline_flexible.description: Only after the tool asked whether the date is fixed

start_text.description: When they want to start, in their words

budget_max_inr.description: ONLY if the caller volunteered a budget. Top of their range in rupees. Never ask.

function.name: get_consultation_slots
function.description: Only after evaluate_enquiry returned QUALIFIED. Returns up to three free consultation slots (slot_id + spoken label) and `say` offering them.

function.name: book_consultation
function.description: Book the slot the caller chose. Pass the slot_id exactly as returned by get_consultation_slots. The backend refuses any caller the rules have not qualified.

function.name: escalate_existing_client
function.description: Existing Aangan client with a problem or complaint about an ongoing project. Alerts the studio head immediately and queues a priority callback.

issue.description: One or two lines in the caller's words

complaint.description: false if it's a routine question, not a complaint

function.name: request_human_callback
function.description: Caller wants a person, prefers Marathi, needs a slot we can't offer, said yes to a designer call after NURTURE, or anything you can't handle. Queues a callback (never between 9pm and 9am).
